title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 4
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. This conversation includes the recent bubblejett Custom OG mint, details on our move to Unreal Engine 5, mobile game updates, special guest, and of course... a little leak!

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
0:20 - Beverage Choices
0:55 - General Updates
1:44 - Leak #1
2:33 - Unreal Engine 5
7:00 - Ongoing OG Mint
8:30 - New Wallet Integration
9:50 - Mobile Game Updates
10:25 - Rob's Cell Phone Collection
14:12 - Security + Play 2 Earn
16:07 - Upcoming NFT Sale
18:00 - New NFT Sale Tech
19:26 - Land Sale Update
22:40 - Chad? Josh? Wait, what?
23:45 - Best Land Sale... Ever?!?
25:10 -  Introducing Indiana Jones
26:15 - Matt's role
28:10 - COPI Discord
30:10 - How to become and OG
33:30 - Surprise Gift
34:40 - Matt's NFT Journey
35:45 - Cornucopias NFT Strategy
38:18 - Final Leak
40:45 - Another Interesting Gift?

Be sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more developments from the Cornucopias metaverse project! Also, check out our social channels below:

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game

$COPI Token is available to purchase on https://app.minswap.org/swap.
